editorial_question.en: Confirm treatment of sacrifice for Church and faithful; distinguish communion of saints, papal/bishop references, and historical origins of the remembered names.
editorial_question.fr: Contrôler l'explication du sacrifice pour l'Église et les fidèles, la communion des saints et les références au pape, à l'évêque et aux personnes commémorées.

editorial_question.en: Verify the five Latin petition adjectives one by one against Gihr, Guéranger, Aquinas, and the original Roman Missal, avoiding the claim that each sign of the Cross causes a separate consecration.
editorial_question.fr: Vérifier un par un les cinq adjectifs de la supplication latine chez Gihr, Guéranger, saint Thomas et dans le Missel, sans attribuer une consécration à chaque signe de croix.

editorial_question.en: Compare the words and actions over Host and Chalice with the original source and the Roman Catechism; distinguish doctrinal teaching from exact 1962 wording and ceremonial instructions.
editorial_question.fr: Confronter paroles et gestes sur l'Hostie et le Calice au texte original et au Catéchisme romain, en distinguant doctrine, formule de 1962 et rubriques.

editorial_question.en: Check how the anamnesis and sacrificial terms are explained by St Alphonsus and Aquinas; keep the Passion, Resurrection and Ascension in their source order.
editorial_question.fr: Vérifier l'anamnèse et le vocabulaire sacrificiel chez saint Alphonse et saint Thomas, en conservant l'ordre Passion, Résurrection, Ascension.

editorial_question.en: Compare Gihr and St Alphonsus on Abel, Abraham and Melchisedech; distinguish the Canon's explicit named figures from the separately owned Genesis/Hebrews study links.
editorial_question.fr: Comparer Gihr et saint Alphonse sur Abel, Abraham et Melchisédech ; distinguer les figures nommées par le Canon des liens d'étude biblique qui relèvent d'un autre propriétaire.

editorial_question.en: Reconcile Aquinas on the holy Angel and heavenly altar with Guéranger, Le Brun and the original prayer, avoiding an exclusive identification of the Angel.
editorial_question.fr: Rapprocher l'analyse de saint Thomas concernant l'Ange et l'autel céleste avec Guéranger, Le Brun et la prière, sans identifier exclusivement l'Ange.

editorial_question.en: Distinguish the Memento of the dead from Nobis quoque and Per quem; do not introduce unapproved commemorations or invent extra priest gestures.
editorial_question.fr: Distinguer le Memento des défunts, Nobis quoque et Per quem, sans créer de commémorations non approuvées ni de nouveaux gestes du prêtre.

editorial_question.en: These two blocks have no mapped historical-author claim in this P0 snapshot. Strengthen the explanation using the printed doxology and the existing Formation lesson, not an invented missing source.
editorial_question.fr: Ces deux blocs n'ont pas de fiche d'auteur historique dans ce relevé P0. Approfondir à partir de la doxologie imprimée et de Formation existante, sans inventer une source.

primary_source_spot_checks.finding: Aquinas explicitly connects the Eucharistic prayer with the Church's unity; precise application to Te igitur is editorial, not a newly certified 1962 rubric.
The separate consecrated species signify Christ's sacrificial death, while the risen Christ is not sacrificed by another bloody death.
Aquinas distinguishes the sacrament's representation of Christ's Passion and the fruits communicated from that one sacrifice.

primary_source_spot_checks.finding: The Pope explicitly names Abel, Abraham and Melchisedech as prefigurations of Christ's sacrifice in the Roman Canon.

primary_source_spot_checks.locus: Summa theologiae III q.83 a.4 ad 8
primary_source_spot_checks.finding: Aquinas treats ancient sacrifices as acceptable for the devotion of their offerers, while the Eucharistic sacrifice is superior.

primary_source_spot_checks.locus: Summa theologiae III q.83 a.4 ad 9
